Name: Lucy's Artifact Shop - Roommate Update

Description:

[center][i][color=#cfe2f3][size=4]Now with DDFC Scaler and Stardew Expanded patches[/size][/color][color=#cfe2f3]![/color][/i][/center]



[color=#00ffff][size=5]Update 2.5: [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=5]Roommate Edition [/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]{[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]WIP-ish}[/size][/color]
Save Lucy from her dirty, ground sleeping, existence and have yourself a live-in nudist as a roommate.
Heart triggered gifts, new events, and a few silly additions.




[center][size=4][b]Conspiracy Theorist, Nap Enthusiast... Exhibitionist?[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Lucy[/b], a fresh graduate of Zuzu City's College of Archaeology, has come to Pelican Town seeking treasure and adventure. Drawn by tales of riches in the mines and the strange disappearance of the local museum's artifacts, Lucy cannot resist the mystery... or the potential profit. To fund her expeditions into the depths, she plans to set up shop, held back only by her own quirky dispositions.


[size=4][u][b]Features![/b][/u][/size]

[list]
[*]An artifact shop whose inventory increases as your relationship with Lucy does. (Will provide all artifacts)[/*]
[*]Location dependent sprites, Large Portraits, Custom Mail[/*]
[*]Nested dialog choices. Randomized Dialog ("Lewd Gacha" for Spa and Saloon).[/*]
[*]Catch Lucy "napping" at various locations. A few of saucy events.[/*]
[*]Lucy can become your roommate, and visit the resort.[/*]
[/list]

[center][size=4][[b][color=#e06666]Content Warning[/color][/b]:  Unavoidable Explicit Nudity. Implied Sexual Interactions.][/size][/center]
[center][size=4] [There is no explicit sex. Lucy is of legal age.] [/size][/center]

[b][u][size=4]The Slant to the Sway[/size][/u][/b]

This mod got away from me a little bit. Started with just trying to make a store, then it snowballed. Tested several features as to have a few working templates in my toolbox. If anyone wants to use my jsons as examples -  please do so :)

Ignore shop pic warning in SMAPI.

The first time you click on Lucy's tent or pinboard the DDFC may derp out, but it works afterwards.

This mod was made with a resolution of [b][size=4]1920 x1080[/size][/b]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44971]DDFC Scaler[/url] may work for you if you don't share my resolution.
